findings.title: Copied config with display schedule_type is built but never used
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies `monitor.config` into `config` and replaces `schedule_type` with its display value. The returned dict then uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original) instead of `config`. The copy is dead code, so the occurrence's monitor context carries the raw numeric `schedule_type` instead of the human-readable one the code intends. The bug was already in `mark_failed.py`, but this PR moves the function into a new module, so it is a good time to fix it by using `config` in the returned dict or removing the copy.
